dxvk-remix (https://github.com/NVIDIAGameWorks/dxvk-remix), commit 0867d3c748a7, MIT-licensed parts only.

FUSE Relight ports selected MIT-licensed runtime and bridge sources from dxvk-remix. Every ported file
keeps the notice below verbatim in its source and adds "Modifications Copyright (c) 2026 FUSE
contributors (MIT)". No file of dxvk-remix under any other licence is used, and no NVIDIA runtime
binary is shipped.
